reviews.text: We have just completed a puppy course and can recommend this. Our instructor Tobias was clear and informative. They emphasized that all participants were able to complete the exercises. We had some educational evenings. It was also a big plus that we got access to our own Facebook page with useful information and videos.
I have taken advantage of the puppy course and the basic course, we felt we were seen and received good follow-up on both courses. Skilled and pleasant instructors. Recommended!

I attended the puppy course in the fall of 2023, and am very impressed by the level, the professional knowledge, and the teaching methods used to get the puppy to understand what you want to achieve.

We went from 0-100 in record time in contact with the puppy, recall, meeting other dogs, meeting people, dressage (sit, cover, in place etc.), some agility, basic sport training and several other extremely useful skills. The instructors were both fun, knowledgeable, skilled and dedicated - and just the right amount of strictness. This was simply fun to attend for both two- and four-legged friends. Highly recommended! Now we are registered for the next level, the basic course. Thank you for us so far!
